the-silent-partner/adaeze.description: A 36-year-old Nigerian woman from Lagos, an Igbo finance director educated in Nigeria: a warm, low, composed voice with a clear Nigerian English accent — Nigerian vowels and rhythm — speaking quietly and precisely.

the-silent-partner/tunde.description: A 47-year-old Yoruba man from Lagos, a chief executive: a big, warm, booming baritone with a strong Lagos Nigerian English accent, confident and charming, a laugh never far away.

the-silent-partner/ifeoma.description: A 28-year-old Igbo woman from Enugu working in a Lagos office: a bright, quick, slightly breathy young voice with a natural Nigerian English accent, polite and nervous.

the-silent-partner/eze.description: A 69-year-old Igbo chief who chairs a company board: a deep, slow, grave voice with an old-school Nigerian English accent, every word weighed and commanding.

the-silent-partner/guard.description: A 52-year-old night security guard in Lagos: a soft, tired, kind voice with a strong everyday Yoruba-influenced Nigerian accent, humble and gentle.

the-silent-partner/funke.description: A 63-year-old Yoruba housekeeper from Lagos: a small, firm, dignified older woman's voice with a strong Yoruba Nigerian English accent, careful and honest.
